plan.title: Athena patterns: source trust, topic-drift nudge, dual-threshold budget
plan.goal: Add three bounded, stdlib-only, option-driven behaviors to existing harness modules
success_criteria: Journeys J1-J3 pass in registered tests and are validated live after deployment
Each feature has a kill switch and an observable counter or event
No new dependency and no ranking-quality claim without promotion_gate evidence

items.name: Skeptical-prior source trust

items.name: Rate-limited topic-drift memory nudge
items.goal: EWMA drift over the already computed query vector; measure-only by default, bounded constant hint opt-in

items.name: Dual-threshold loop budget
items.goal: Soft wrap-up and hard finalize signals with a reserve floor in the local agent loop

items.name: Live validation and enforce decision
items.goal: Validate J1-J3 live after deployment; add aq-qa probes and dashboard surfacing; decide A1 enforce and A2 hint defaults from promotion_gate evidence
